integrity: Both complete exact-integer standalone verification methods agree on all 30 profiles; source objects, matrix normalizations, and rational descent are explicitly proved.
scientific_limitations: Only the S7 permutation forms from general-position septuples and their central Geiser quadratic twists in odd characteristic; not arbitrary W(E7) types or point-scheme realization for every field. Historical priority and external validation remain open.
title: Thirty Frobenius chamber spectra for seven-point degree-two del Pezzo surfaces and their Geiser twists
